paper.title: Towards minimax policies for online linear optimization with bandit feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Online linear optimization with bandit feedback, finite action set of N actions
unmapped: Losses bounded: |a^T z| <= 1 for all a in A, z in Z (dual action sets)
Finite action set of size N
settings.definition_quote: at each time instance $t = 1, \hdots, n$, the player chooses, possibly in a randomized way, an action from a given compact action set $\cA \subset \R^d$... We consider here the {\em bandit} version, where the player only observes the incurred loss $a_t^{\top} z_t$... $\cA$ and $\cZ$ are such that $|a^{\top} z| \leq 1, \forall (a,z) \in \cA \times \cZ$.

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit linear optimization on the hypercube with cross-polytope losses
unmapped: Action set A = {x: ||x||_inf <= 1}, loss set Z = {z: ||z||_1 <= 1}
settings.definition_quote: Consider the online linear optimization problem with bandit feedback on $\cA = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\|_{\infty} \leq 1 \}$, and with $\cZ = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\|_{1} \leq 1 \}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit linear optimization on the Euclidean ball
unmapped: Action set and loss set both the Euclidean unit ball
settings.definition_quote: Consider the online linear optimization problem with bandit feedback on $\cA = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1 \}$, and with $\cZ = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1 \}$.

bound.regime: gamma = eta d, eta = sqrt(log N/(3 n d))

extra_assumptions: action set preprocessed so John's ellipsoid of conv(A) is unit ball

source.label: th:exp2john
source.quote: {\sc exp2} with John's exploration and estimate \eqref{eq:banditestimate} satisfies, for $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq 1$, $$R_n \leq 2 \gamma n + \frac{\log N}{\eta} + \eta n d.$$ In particular with $\gamma = \eta d$ and $\eta = \sqrt{\frac{\log N}{3 n d}}$ we have that $$R_n \leq 2 \sqrt{3 n d \log N} .$$

results.notes: Regret defined as E sum - min_a E sum (pseudo-regret). Computing John's ellipsoid may be hard in general; exp2 is linear in N per round.

source.label: th:hypercube
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA$ with regularizer~(\ref{eq:entro-reg}) satisfies, for any $\eta$ and $\gamma \in (0,1)$ such that $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq \frac12$, ... In particular, with $\gamma = 2 d \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$, $R_n \leq 2 d \sqrt{3 n \log 2}$.

results.notes: Paper states computational complexity linear in d.

bound.regime: gamma = 1/sqrt(n), eta = sqrt(log n/(2nd)), eta d <= 1/2

source.label: th:ball
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA' = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1-\gamma \}$ with the estimate \eqref{eq:ballestimate}, and $F(x) = - \log (1 - \|x\|) - \|x\|$ satisfies, for any $\eta$ such that $\eta d \leq \frac12$, ... In particular, with $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log n}{2 n d}}$, $R_n \leq 3 \sqrt{d n \log n}$.
